title: German Unity Day in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **3 October is Germany's national holiday**, marking reunification on 3 October 1990. In 2026 it falls on a Saturday, so Berlin runs Sunday closure rules on both 3 and 4 October.
**Regular shops, malls and supermarkets close all day.** The station shops carry the weekend: REWE Ostbahnhof 06:00 to 24:00, REWE Hauptbahnhof and EDEKA Friedrichstrasse roughly 08:00 to 22:00.
**Bakeries may sell baked goods from 07:00 to 16:00**, and restaurants, cafes and bars run a normal, busy holiday Saturday. Book dinner ahead.
**Museums stay open.** The state museums open as on a Sunday, most from 10:00 to 18:00, and the Deutsches Historisches Museum makes its Pei building free on Unity Day.
**The national celebration is in Bremen in 2026**, from 2 to 4 October. Berlin's own weekend runs on TAG DER CLUBKULTUR's opening night and the medieval festival at Spandau Citadel.
**Transport runs the Sunday timetable** with normal weekend night service, S9 and FEX to BER included. Do your real shopping on Friday 2 October; checked on 31 August 2026.
